name: DragonFLY
summary: DragonFLY, also known as DFLY or H-DFLY, is a serotonin receptor agonist of the phenethylamine, DOx, and FLY families. It is the "dragonFLY" (benzodifuran) analogue of 2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine (2,5-DMA or DOH).

pharmacology.text: The enantiomers of DFLY, (R)-DFLY and (S)-DFLY, show affinity and activity at the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors. At the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, the affinity (Ki) of (R)-DFLY was 1.5 nM and of (S)-DFLY was 37.9 nM, while at the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor, the affinity (Ki) of (R)-DFLY was 0.79 nM and of (S)-DFLY was 6.0 nM.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist
